A short statement, posted as an image, about how the term “noise envelope” was rendered in Chinese in the Ziyu Acoustics series “Tackling aircraft noise.” A noise envelope is a set of limits on an airport’s noise impact, used to manage its growth.

The post links to the UK Civil Aviation Authority’s 2013 report CAP 1129, Noise Envelopes. The statement itself is in the image in the original WeChat post.
